name: Signature Pad
description:
A page item where users sign with a mouse, finger or pen, or type their name, and the signature is saved as an image.

Value: an image data URL (PNG, JPEG or SVG). Set Session State Data Type to CLOB. Save it to a BLOB with apex_web_service.clobbase642blob( substr( :P1_SIGNATURE, instr( :P1_SIGNATURE, ',' ) + 1 ) ). Drawing: smooth, pressure-like lines (the faster the pen, the thinner the line), undo, clear, a signature line and a placeholder. With Pen Choices, users pick the line color and size (Fine, Medium, Bold). The pad is responsive: on narrow screens it keeps a 2:1 shape up to the Height, and the signature scales to fit when the pad changes size. Type Instead: users type their name and it is drawn in a handwriting font, so the item also works with a keyboard.

Live demo: https://oracleapex.com/ords/r/aamirkhanz/plugins/signature-pad (user demo, password Demo).

Requires Oracle APEX 26.2 or later. Documentation, updates and more plug-ins: https://www.techrevx.com
